Olivia (Accounting): Quick question 4k vendor rebate posted to Feb invoices but vendor confirmed it relates to December usage. Need guidance on posting: prior-period adj or current JE to reclass?
Ben (Billing): The rebate came as CM-6221 applied 2026-02-05 across several customer invoices. Total RCM = $43,200. CM PDF: https://files.redwood/CM-6221.pdf
Hannah (Revenue): Running numbers now. Dec ARR was ~3.4M, so this is ~1.27% of monthly. Per policy >1% requires disclosure. We should prepare a prior-period adjustment memo for auditors.
Sanjay (Controller): Agreed. Prepare the adjustment memo, include customer-level recalcs, and liaise with Audit. If auditors accept current-period correcting JE, we'll document their waiver.
Olivia (Accounting): Draft JE if auditors allow current-period correcting entry:
Date: 2026-03-15
DR Recognized Revenue (GL 4000) ...... $43,200
CR Accounts Receivable (GL 1100) ..... $43,200
DR Accounts Receivable (GL 1100) ..... $43,200
CR Deferred Revenue (GL 2100) ........ $43,200
Narrative: Reclassification of vendor rebate CM-6221 misapplied to Feb; reclass to Dec deferred revenue. Support: vendor memo + billing logs.
Ben (Billing): I'll generate the CM application CSV and attach evidence to audit ticket AR-3349.
auditor-bot: Audit ticket created AR-3349. Please provide evidence within 72 hours for preliminary review.
Hannah (Revenue): Also need to update revenue schedules and ARR notes if we do prior-period. Let me know so I can rerun forecasts.
Sanjay (Controller): Proceed with packet prep and route to Jared for sign-off if necessary.
Olivia (Accounting): On it. Will update this thread when packet uploaded.
